title: DUEL CHANNEL: IVY VINE LIMITED-TIME EVENT OPEN
lines: 01 DUEL CHANNEL: IVY VINE LIMITED-TIME EVENT OPEN
DETAILS: During the event, players can earn [Grand Duel Fireworks] by participating in event stages and completing Daily Activity, and level up the [Ivy Vine Program] to receive event rewards.
REWARDS: Event Furniture 'Duel Trophy - Courage', Event Icon 'ALL IN!', Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, and more.
02 NEW ARRIVALS AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following new Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided - Unstained, Unshaken for Saria
Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided - Requiem Vesperis for Lemuen
Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided - As Clear As Crystal for Necrass
DETAILS: The following packs will be available from the Store for a limited time.
◆ This Profile Theme can be switched among different Operators: Virtuosa, Necrass, Ulpianus, Lemuen, and Pramanix the Prerita.
◆ This Profile Theme can be switched among different Operators: Hoshiguma the Breacher, Nian, Yu, Leizi the Thunderbringer, and Tragodia.
◆ This Profile Theme can be switched among different Operators: Passenger, Magallan, Saria, SilverAsh the Reignfrost, and Degenbrecher.
◆ This Profile Theme can be switched among different Operators: Zima, Mon3tr, Amiya, Mantra, and Wiš'adel.
DETAILS: Stages will unlock based on the amount of Commendation Certificates spent, with the required amount for each stage unchanged. New items will also be added to Stage 2.
Please stay tuned for more information!
